text_block_list.text:
In Round 4 of the Representative Exchange 
Race, which heavily influenced the 
selection for Japan's representatives, <chrname> 
claimed a magnificent victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching the project members run with all 
their heart and soul— Mei Satake had 
already decided in her mind which 
Umamusume deserved to take the grand 
stage.
